subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
(c)  Ms. Shalini, an articled clerk in Namrata & Co. LLP, has the following
questions while going through SQC-1. Guide her on the following:
(i)  Can the firm have a mechanism to ensure compliance with
independence requirements?
(2 Marks)

AUDITING AND ETHICS

21
(ii)  Is engagement quality review mandatory for all engagements?
(1 Mark)
(iii)  Can the firm obtain from Ms. Shalini a written confirmation of
compliance with the firm's policies and procedures on independence?
(1 Mark)
suggested_answer:
(c) (i) There should exist a mechanism in the firm by which engagement
partners provide the firm with relevant information about client
engagements and personnel of firm promptly notify firm of
circumstances and relationships that create a threat to independence.
All breaches of independence should be promptly notified to firm for
appropriate action. Its objective is to ensure that independence
requirements are satisfied.

AUDITING AND ETHICS

23
(ii) Engagement quality control review is mandatory for all audits of
financial statements of listed entities. In respect of other engagements,
firm should devise criteria to determine cases requiring performance
of engagement quality control review.
(iii) At least annually, the firm should obtain written confirmation of
compliance with its policies and procedures on independence from all
firm personnel required to be independent in terms of the
requirements of the Code.
